The Activity:

Write your own recipe! It could be for the thing you made in Activity 1, or it could be for something else.

Some things to think about:

  • Who is the recipe for? This is your audience. The recipe will look different if it is for children or adults to follow. It might also look different depending on if it is for adult beginners or people who are more confident.
  • Think about the parts you need to include – what it is, ingredients, equipment etc.
  • Think about how you are going to set your recipe out on the page to make it easy to follow.
  • Think about how to write your sentences. What you choose might depend on your audience – some people will need simpler sentences and some people might be partly reading the recipe for fun and want some more descriptive sections.
